title: Last Substring in Lexicographical Order
summary: For a given string s, identify and return the final substring that appears last in alphabetical order.
statement: For a given string s, identify and return the final substring that appears last in alphabetical order.
reference_solution:
def lexicographically_last_substring(s):
 i,j,k=0,1,0;n=len(s)
 while j+k<n:
  if s[i+k]==s[j+k]:k+=1;continue
  if s[i+k]<s[j+k]:i=max(i+k+1,j);j=i+1
  else:j=j+k+1
  k=0
 return s[i:]

Reset the matched length after advancing a candidate.
Every discarded start loses a direct lexicographic comparison, leaving the unique best suffix start.
